name: Philosophy
overview: Scripture reveals that true understanding and wisdom come from seeking God, who performs great and unsearchable works beyond human comprehension, as illustrated in Job 5:8-11. Human philosophy, including Greek and rabbinical schools, attempts to explain the nature of things and God's providence, but it is insufficient for full knowledge or salvation through Christ's atonement. The Bible shows that God frustrates the plans of the crafty and the wise in their own devices (Job 5:12-13), emphasizing that philosophical reasoning alone was not the method Paul used to preach the gospel.
